group.label: Preference group
group.hint: Set the same preference-group number for programs considered equivalent. Group 1 is preferred to group 2, etc.
group.longHint: Use the same preference-group number for the programs you consider tied. Lower group numbers are preferred. The app will test every possible order inside each tied group, so you can see whether the exact internal order changes the predicted outcome.

card.detailsFor: Characteristics of {program} as loaded from the calibration data.
card.unavailable: This program is no longer available in the loaded data.

dnd.instructions: Press space bar to pick up the program. Use the arrow keys to move it, space bar to drop it, and escape to cancel.
dnd.onDragStart: Picked up {program}. It is at preference {position} of {total}.
dnd.onDragCancel: Reordering cancelled. {program} is back at preference {position} of {total}.

priorities.title: Do you have priority at this establishment?
priorities.hint: Mark only the situations that apply to this specific establishment. SAE recognizes the four priority criteria below.

descriptions.sibling: You have a sibling enrolled at the establishment
descriptions.student: You have priority-student status for this establishment
descriptions.parentCivilServant: You are the child of an employee of the establishment
descriptions.exStudent: You previously attended the establishment and were not expelled
descriptions.alreadyRegistered: You are already enrolled in this establishment

priorities.alreadyRegisteredNote: Current enrollment is shown separately because it is not one of the four SAE priority criteria.
priorities.none: No priority declared for this program
